envelope.description: Add Locator, Pointer, StalenessResult and PathValidationResult interfaces to src/workflow/artifact-core/types.ts

body.title: Add Locator, Pointer, StalenessResult and PathValidationResult interfaces to src/workflow/artifact-core/types.ts
body.summary: Add a new, clearly-labeled section (e.g. '// --- shared-reviewcontext-data-model Epic sc1/sc2/sc6 (Locator/Pointer/staleness/path-validation), owned by s1 ---') at the end of src/workflow/artifact-core/types.ts defining: type LocatorKind = 'symbol' | 'lineRange' | 'docSection'; interface Locator { kind, value }; interface Pointer { path, section?, contentHash? }; interface StalenessResult { stale, checkedAt }; interface PathValidationResult { ok, violations }. No functions in this Task -- types only.
acceptanceChecks: Locator, Pointer, StalenessResult and PathValidationResult are exported from src/workflow/artifact-core/types.ts with exactly the field shapes the LLD's dataModelChanges describe
The new section is labeled unambiguously with this Epic's own name, not a bare 'sc1/sc2/sc6' that could be confused with this file's existing, differently-scoped sc-labeled sections
tsc typechecks the file with no errors

tests.name: Locator, Pointer, StalenessResult and PathValidationResult are exported with the exact documented field shapes
